entity_title: Join BPJS Kesehatan after 6 months - even with private cover
fact_text: The national health-insurance regulation (Perpres 82/2018) defines participants to include foreigners who work at least 6 months in Indonesia, so long-stay foreign workers must join BPJS Kesehatan. The obligation stands even if you also hold private or international health cover.
evidence_quote: yang bekerja paling singkat 6 (enam) bulan di Indonesia

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed private or international insurance exempts you from the state scheme. Actually foreigners working 6 months or more must still enroll in BPJS Kesehatan. Action: budget the payroll-based BPJS Kesehatan contribution on top of any private plan.
